title: Brake pedal boundary values
objective: Verify brake pedal signal at range boundaries
preconditions: Vehicle in test mode; pedal rig connected
steps: 1. Apply 0% pedal press; 2. Apply 100% pedal press; 3. Apply 101% (inject fault)
expected_result: 1. Output reads 0%; 2. Output reads 100%; 3. System flags BRAKE_INVALID within 10 ms

title: SG-01 acceleration limit
objective: Verify vehicle does not accelerate unintentionally
preconditions: Vehicle stationary; ignition on; foot off pedal
steps: 1. Hold for 30 s; 2. Inject stuck-high pedal sensor fault
expected_result: 1. Acceleration < 0.1 m/s^2; 2. System enters safe state within 10 ms

title: Diagnostic log on fault
objective: Verify log entry created on ASIL-C fault
steps: 1. Inject fault code F_042 with sensor value 200; 2. Read non-volatile memory
expected_result: Log entry with correct timestamp, F_042, sensor value 200 present within 50 ms

title: Cruise activation happy path
objective: Verify cruise activates in valid conditions
